incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired for service: inference-api (high urgency) — 5xx rate spike > 5% across eu-west-1. Link: <https://pagerduty.example/p/incidents/PD12345>
alex (oncall): saw the page. starting investigation. paging logs now.
alex (oncall): checking recent deploys and routing rules. no deploys in the last 30m.
alex (oncall): `curl -sS https://metrics.internal/api/5xx?service=inference-api | jq .` shows errors concentrated on model shard 3
pagerduty: No acknowledgement from alex (oncall) within 120s — escalation rule: notify secondary
pagerduty: Escalated to maria (secondary-oncall)
maria (secondary-oncall): taking. jumping into pod logs and pyro metrics.
maria (secondary-oncall): seeing OOMs on worker-3 and high GC in python process.
jamal (eng-runtime): thanks — that matches an intermittent memory leak we saw in 0.9.4 candidate. Are we running 0.9.4 on prod yet?
alex (oncall): prod is on 0.9.3. but one of the autoscaled nodes got a container with 0.9.4 image — weird. Could be mixed image causing bad kernel/compat.
sophie (support): We have two active customer threads reporting failures: AcmeCorp (enterprise) and BetaRetail — both on eu-west. Customers seeing 502s and repeated `model tokenization` errors.
maria (secondary-oncall): spinning up additional capacity in eu-west-1 and draining the suspect host. running scale command:
```
rbctl pool scale inference-eu-west --add 2 --reason "emergency: worker OOMs"
kubectl cordon node ip-10-0-3-45 && kubectl drain node ip-10-0-3-45 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data
```
alex (oncall): I can confirm a single host (ip-10-0-3-45) had a 0.9.4 container with a miscompiled libnvrtc causing repeated segmentation faults.
jamal (eng-runtime): rolling back that node's image tag and restarting the runtime agent on the node. command I ran:
```
ssh ubuntu@ip-10-0-3-45 sudo docker tag redwood/runtime:0.9.3 redwood/runtime:prod && sudo systemctl restart redwood-runtime
```
pagerduty: Incident acknowledgement recorded by maria (secondary-oncall) at 1792004385
maria (secondary-oncall): after scaling and cordon the error rate dropped ~80% — still seeing a small tail of 502s while KV caches warm up.
alex (oncall): switching on fallback routing: divert 25% traffic to quantized-v1 model for eu-west to lower memory pressure.
jamal (eng-runtime): applied routing rule: 
```
POST /api/v1/routing/change {"region":"eu-west-1","route_to":"quantized-v1","pct":25}
```
sophie (support): notifying AcmeCorp: "We're investigating an infrastructure issue affecting inference in eu-west. We've applied mitigations (scaling & routing). We'll update in 15m or sooner." :phone:
sam (eng-sre-manager): note: pagerduty escalated to manager because initial ACK window missed. We'll follow up on oncall schedule and consider increasing primary ACK window to 180s for this service. Also want a post-incident review for mixed-image detection in autoscaler.
alex (oncall): handing off from oncall -> maria for the next 30m while I finish customer post-updates. Maria, can you own the final verification & postmortem notes?
maria (secondary-oncall): yes, I will own verification and collect logs. will also capture exact pod IDs and node info for the postmortem.
jamal (eng-runtime): action item: add autoscaler check to ensure image tag consistency before spinning new node. I'll open an RFC/PR after this.
sophie (support): CS follow-up: customers asked for ETA for full recovery. estimate: 15-30m for caches to warm and rollout to complete. keeping them updated now.
alex (oncall): good. after-action items: (1) runbook update for mixed-image detection, (2) adjust PD ACK timeout, (3) add autoscaler image consistency check. I'll create tickets.
incident-bot: Reminder: create incident report using `/incident create` and tag sev2, impacted-services: inference-api, regions: eu-west-1
maria (secondary-oncall): will run one final pass: verifying no OOMs for 15m, all 5xx rates < 0.5% and latency normal.
alex (oncall): thanks everyone. closing live mitigation thread — will update when postmortem draft is ready. :white_check_mark:
sophie (support): marking customer threads as "mitigation applied" and setting follow-up reminders.
sam (eng-sre-manager): schedule a 1hr postmortem tomorrow. include runtime, autoscaler and oncall rotation leads. Also confirm PD escalation settings and add a missed-ack remote playbook.
jamal (eng-runtime): +1. prepping logs and perf traces now.
pagerduty: Incident PD12345 resolved by maria (secondary-oncall) at 1792004789
maria (secondary-oncall): resolved. final note: root cause appears to be a mis-published 0.9.4 image in the autoscaler pool leading to one node running incompatible runtime causing memory faults. follow-up: block mixed tags on new nodes and add image verification step.
